projects.name: Solar + Energy Storage on Garage
projects.description: Install 5-7 solar panels on south-facing garage roof face (20x12 ft, ~2-2.8 kW) plus battery storage. Solar = standalone ROI investment (~5yr payback at $0.42/kWh). Battery = generator alternative (no lot space for generator). 30% federal ITC applies to both when paired.
projects.notes: DESIGN: South garage face only. 5 portrait panels = 2.0 kW; 7 mixed = 2.8 kW. ~3,200-4,500 kWh/yr production (20-26% offset). All-in after ITC: solar ~$9-10k, battery ~$9-10k. VENDORS: Sunergy (sunergy.com) — EnergySage 2026 CA Installer of Year, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door. NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com) — Diamond Certified, 35yr, San Mateo County, 40yr warranty. Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy) — online only. AVOID: Sunrun.

tasks.title: Analyze energy usage and size system
tasks.notes: 17,178 kWh/yr at $0.42/kWh avg. Target: 5-7 panels south garage face (20x12 ft) = 2-2.8 kW. ~5yr payback after ITC.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist solar installers
tasks.notes: Shortlist: Sunergy (sunergy.com, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door), NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com, Diamond Certified, San Mateo County), Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy, online only). Avoid Sunrun.

tasks.title: Contact installers for quotes
tasks.notes: Spec: south garage face (20x12 ft, 5-7 panels, ~2-2.8 kW), paired battery (Enphase IQ or Powerwall 3), detached garage sub-panel interconnect. Ask each for: $/W, panel brand, inverter type, battery spec, warranty, timeline, ITC total. Request free shade/LIDAR analysis.

tasks.title: Compare quotes and select installer
tasks.notes: Prefer Enphase microinverters over string inverter. Compare $/W, battery spec, warranty, timeline. 30% ITC on full system incl. battery.

tasks.title: Confirm ITC timing — credit files in year PTO is granted
tasks.notes: 30% federal ITC on Form 5695. Claimed in tax year Permission to Operate granted by PG&E. Battery qualifies only when solar-paired. Plan install timing accordingly.

insights.summary: The stable 22-24 device count combined with zero camera motion and confirmed deep sleep for both adults indicates the household is fully asleep and undisturbed; the elevated count is likely background IoT devices or charging electronics rather than active presence, confirming a normal nighttime state with no immediate security concerns.

The combination of confirmed adult sleep data, zero camera motion, and a sustained 22-24 device count at 1 AM indicates the household is fully asleep, but the unusually high network load points to smart home devices or IoT gadgets failing to enter sleep mode rather than human activity or a security breach.

The sustained 22-24 connected devices paired with zero camera motion on a weekday night strongly indicates a large group of guests is present but stationary, likely gathered in a common area for a movie night or party. This explains the elevated device count without typical household movement, confirming a social gathering rather than a security or system anomaly.

The sustained 22-24 connected devices far exceeds the household's typical baseline, and combined with zero camera motion on a weekday evening, strongly indicates a small gathering or sleepover is taking place in a camera-blind area. This explains the anomaly but warrants a quick check to ensure it aligns with household plans.

The sustained 22-24 device count paired with zero camera motion over a 3.5-hour weekday evening strongly indicates a large group of guests is settled indoors, likely occupying separate rooms or a common area without triggering motion sensors. This pattern confirms a social gathering rather than typical family activity, explaining the high connectivity without expected household movement.

The sustained 22-24 device count paired with zero camera motion on a weekday evening strongly indicates a quiet gathering or guests are present, likely with motion detection temporarily paused or cameras focused away to avoid false alerts during the event.

The stable count of 21-24 connected devices paired with zero camera motion throughout the weekday evening strongly suggests a quiet gathering of guests in a camera-blind area. This matters because it indicates either a specific gathering location or a potential camera malfunction that should be verified.

The sustained connection of 21-24 devices paired with zero camera motion strongly suggests guests are gathered in camera-blind zones, outside, or the cameras are offline; verifying this is important to rule out security gaps or technical failures during a weekday evening.

The sustained high device count (16-22) paired with zero camera motion on a weekday afternoon confirms the home is unoccupied, with family devices left connected to the network rather than indicating a gathering or camera malfunction.

The steady increase in connected devices (16 to 22) paired with zero camera motion over four hours strongly indicates a gathering in a camera-blind zone (e.g., backyard or garage) or a camera network outage; verify camera status and monitor for unrecorded activity.
